detail: Findings: warning: Review subagents repeatedly wrote files INTO this repo despite explicit instructions not to mutate it — test/eval/scorers/*.ts (edited then reverted), test/migrate/zzz-adversarial-repro.test.ts, test/coordination/zz-order-proof.test.ts, test/zz-tmp-warning-budget-verify.test.ts. All were reproduction harnesses; moved to scratchpad as evidence, none kept. Treat 'read-only' review agents as capable of writes unless sandboxed in a worktree.; warning: The Stop hook fired demanding a record when THIS session had edited nothing since its last twining_record — the edits were made by background subagents writing test files into the repo. The hook's edit marker cannot distinguish subagent writes from the controlling session's, so background agent activity produces false gate demands on the controller. Related to the existing subagent-controller-commits guidance.; The full-suite result of 110 files/1453 tests taken earlier in this session was measured against a tree containing transient subagent edits; the clean re-run is 109 files/1452 passed, 2 skipped. Test counts during a session with active review agents are not stable.; Workflow design lesson (not a twining bug): agent() returns null both when a verifier refutes-by-dying and when it genuinely refutes, so a quota exhaustion silently converted unverified findings into 'refuted'. Score null distinctly from false, or a dead fleet reads as a clean bill of health.
summary: Deep review in progress: field bug fixed and committed; verification re-running on Opus after Fable quota wiped the first pass
